```ts
     | null;

  updatedAt: number;
```

Hand a long (video) generation to this owner's alarm. The caller's request
returns at once; the alarm dispatches the provider exactly once, retains the
output, and releases the lease so a later retry saves and charges it.


Fit one image for a model to look at on the Images binding: always re-encode it
